dialogues.speaker: Wei Fengchen
dialogues.text: The way the world is now, martial nomads who perform heroic deeds have grown few and far between, and those who seek justice like myself are fewer still.

dialogues.speaker: Wei Fengchen
dialogues.text: Do not believe those stories written by that village bumpkin in the mountains. Those are not real heroes...

dialogues.speaker: Wei Fengchen
dialogues.text: I have written my experiences down here. Have a look — they should be enough to clear my name.

dialogues.speaker: Wei Fengchen
dialogues.text: The good, the bad, the ugly... You name it. I've seen it all.

dialogues.speaker: Wei Fengchen
dialogues.text: You... got a score you need me to settle?

dialogues.speaker: Wei Fengchen
dialogues.text: The web of gratitude and grievances... it ensnares us all. When it comes to debt, you're either owed one, or have one to pay.

dialogues.speaker: Wei Fengchen
dialogues.text: As a martial nomad, I've been fighting against the injustice in this world for over ten years now. Sure, you can get vengeance for some, but in most cases, the vicious cycle goes on and on... In the end, you get caught up in it yourself...

dialogues.speaker: Wei Fengchen
dialogues.text: Maybe that's just destiny for people who choose this path. I've come to accept it. There's just... one tiny issue...

dialogues.speaker: Wei Fengchen
dialogues.text: That is a good thing. If there were no injustice in this world, I could quietly return to a more normal life...

dialogues.speaker: Wei Fengchen
dialogues.text: Just that... Um, I haven't eaten in days. Could you get me something to eat?

dialogues.speaker: Wei Fengchen
dialogues.text: If it's alright, I'd like some Mora Meat, Squirrel Fish, Fullmoon Egg, Matsutake and Cured Pork Dry Hotpot, Jueyun Chili Chicken, Jewelry Soup...

dialogues.speaker: Wei Fengchen
dialogues.text: ...Ah, which one do I choose? I need to think about this...
